public.description: A horizontal garden dial, or a vertical dial for a wall (shown lying on its back, face up)

public.description: Custom place: degrees east of Greenwich (west negative), within 30 deg of the zone's meridian

public.description: Clock time of your time zone (the hour lines shifted by the longitude correction; add an hour in summer time), or local solar time (noon along the gnomon)

public.label: Dial size

public.description: Dial and gnomon are cut from the same sheet; the slots follow it
public.label: Plate thickness

public.description: Off: lines, ticks and numerals are engraved (shallow cuts); on: they are cut through the plate (a stencil dial)

public.description: Depth of engraved lines (at most half the plate)
public.label: Engraving depth

public.description: Roman numerals beyond the hour lines (left out where the lines are too close for them)

public.description: Extra width and length of the gnomon's slots: 0 is a press fit, 0.1 to 0.2 mm slides in

public.description: Square hollow section of the legs and rails (EN 10219-2): width x width x wall in mm
public.label: Tube

variables.expr: g / 2 - sqrt(max(0 mm * 1 mm, (hd / 2 + pt / 2) * (hd / 2 + pt / 2) - max(0 mm, eN - dN - rd) * max(0 mm, eN - dN - rd)))
variables.name: aMax

variables.expr: g / 2 + e1 - sqrt(max(0 mm * 1 mm, (hd / 2 + pt / 2 + rd) * (hd / 2 + pt / 2 + rd) - max(0 mm, eN - pt - e1) * max(0 mm, eN - pt - e1)))
variables.name: aE

variables.expr: g / 2 + e1 - sqrt(max(0 mm * 1 mm, (hd / 2 + min(sysWeb, pt / 2) + rd) * (hd / 2 + min(sysWeb, pt / 2) + rd) - max(0 mm, g / 2 - pt - e1) * max(0 mm, g / 2 - pt - e1)))
variables.name: aD

variables.expr: min(3 * pt, floor(2 * (aMax - clr) / (1 mm)) * 1 mm, floor(2 * aE / (1 mm)) * 1 mm, floor(2 * aD / (1 mm)) * 1 mm)
variables.name: tabS

variables.expr: max(ceil((2 * dT + sl + 2 * rd + pt / 2) / g), floor(ribTarget / g))
variables.name: rE

variables.expr: max(pt + legClear + tr / 2, 2 * pt + dT + tabW / 2 + clr + rd)
variables.name: kMin

variables.expr: max(1, min(ceil((L - 2 * pt) / ribStep) - 1, floor((mX - 1) / rE) + 1))
variables.name: nRx

variables.expr: max(1, min(ceil((Wd - 2 * pt) / ribStep) - 1, floor((mY - 1) / rE) + 1))
variables.name: nRy

variables.expr: min(sqrt(max(0 mm, g / 2 - aN) * max(0 mm, g / 2 - aN) + (eN - dN) * (eN - dN)), sqrt((g / 2 - aN + rd) * (g / 2 - aN + rd) + (eN - dN) * (eN - dN)) - rd) - hd / 2
variables.name: webN

variables.expr: sqrt((g / 2 - tabS / 2 + e1) * (g / 2 - tabS / 2 + e1) + (g / 2 - pt - e1) * (g / 2 - pt - e1)) - rd - hd / 2
variables.name: webD

variables.expr: sqrt((g / 2 - tabS / 2 + e1) * (g / 2 - tabS / 2 + e1) + (eN - pt - e1) * (eN - pt - e1)) - rd - hd / 2
variables.name: webE

variables.expr: max(tabStep, xt0, yt0, ribStep - 2 * dT, yr0 - dT - pt, Wd - pt - yrL - dT, xr0 - dT - pt, L - pt - xrL - dT)
variables.name: pitch

variables.expr: webN >= pt / 2 && webE >= pt / 2 && webD >= min(sysWeb, pt / 2)
variables.name: webOk

variables.expr: rd >= 0.5 mm && sw > 4 * rd && sN > 4 * rd && rh / 2 > 2 * rd
variables.name: reliefOk

variables.expr: mX >= 1 && mY >= 1 && ribStep - 2 * dT - sl - 2 * rd >= pt / 2
variables.name: ribsOk
